titulo: Key art e folha de estilo
prompt:
Create a finished, polished game illustration for the action-RPG "Echoes of the Shatter". VISUAL STYLE: match the visual style of the reference game shown in the attached reference sheets as closely as possible. The attached images are contact sheets of that game's assets: hand-painted UV texture atlases of its characters, creatures and environments, portrait atlases, spell icons, VFX sprites/textures, UI atlases, plus their normal maps (lilac), emission/glow maps (black with glowing areas), technical noise/gradient textures and logo marks (reference for finish only). Study them for rendering, palette, brushwork, materials, shape language and UI finish, then render our content as if it were made by the same art team. Do NOT output UV maps, texture atlases or a collage of the sheets; output one coherent finished image. Style traits to reproduce: stylized 3D game look, low-poly chunky bevelled forms whose volume is read through hand-painted textures with visible brush strokes and baked light/shadow plus soft rim light; chibi proportions about 3 to 3.5 heads tall, big readable head silhouettes, thin angular shoulders, distinct oversized props; friendly rounded heroes vs. angular segmented creatures with carapaces, spikes and golden eyes; warm/cool complementary colors (teal/cyan bodies, coral and sand armor plates, gold accents, deep maroon or navy shadows, never pure black), purple 'dark/corrupted' variants; magic as pure neon color with near-white cores and glow (fire orange-yellow, ice cyan-white, lightning electric blue, acid lime, dark purple), thin shapes like rings, diamonds and trails; each world has a saturated signature fog color, floors and props desaturated so characters and spells pop; top-down 3/4 perspective camera; UI made of dark organic stone: purple-grey bevelled stone buttons, black spiky organic frames around bars, lava-orange health fill, yellow highlights. CONTENT comes from our own game script below; all characters, creatures and places are ours: do not reproduce any specific existing character, creature, logo or game title from the reference one-to-one. No readable text, letters, numbers, watermark or logos; use abstract glyph-like marks where text would go.

CONTENT: Key art. A small team of our three heroes (a stout Warrior with a big shield and hammer, a hooded Archer with a long bow, a scholar Mage with a lantern staff) standing on a ruined lantern-lined road, looking at the shattered floating towers of the Archive broken in the sky, a giant cracked bell silhouette, glowing golden memory shards drifting. Strip along the bottom with style swatches: color chips, a floor tile, a torch, an enemy telegraph circle on the ground, a loot light beam, a UI frame. Mood: adventurous with a melancholic edge.

HERO IDENTITY (mandatory): the first attached images are the canonical character sheets of our three heroes. Every hero that appears must match those sheets exactly: same silhouette, proportions, colors, outfit, helmet/hood and weapon. Warrior = golden visor helmet with red plume, red tabard, stone-inlay kite shield, stone block hammer. Archer = green hood with bone beak mask, feathered green cloak, bone recurve bow. Mage = ink-blue pointed hood with visible face, wooden staff with a floating blue crystal in a gold ring, no lantern. Do not invent other heroes or generic adventurers. In this image: all three heroes.
